event.description: Share the head-local attention output map across heads
event.proposal: family: parameter tying; current retained incumbent is 3136 parameters at 99.9500%, a +0.95 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0031, block-diagonal per-head output maps with independent maps at 3136/99.95%; same-family failed result: attempt-0024, tying the two full MQA+FF blocks at 2208/82.12%; prior attempts in this family: 2. Hypothesis: after attempt-0030 showed that cross-head output mixing is unnecessary and attempt-0031 reduced FF width, the two head-local 8x8 maps may also share one transform without changing the representational partition, saving 64 parameters per block for 3072 total. This is more informative than shrinking d_head because it preserves both attention channels and tests only the remaining repeated parameterization; the nearest untested alternative is a head-dimension reduction, which changes attention statistics and capacity simultaneously. Keep d16/h2/L2, MQA, affine-free block pre-norms, final affine norm, learned positions, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3136 parameters.
